# PTC to SCI-MAP: uniform coefficient boundary successor

Boundary identity: `SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP_BOUNDARY v0.2-draft.1/r0.4`. Scientific owner: Grant Wilson.
Status: approved scientific successor, source-bound for reviewed canonical
admission. Exact approved identity spelling, including `draft`, is preserved.

## Inheritance and exact change

This successor incorporates every rule in the unchanged SCI-MAP
predecessor `SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP_BOUNDARY.md`, SHA-256 `a499c59afb69eefda74a5b131ad37afd165213b99324c8b67a6de1d20793c9b7`,
except the previously unselected coefficient slot is now bound for explicit
uniform-family requests by the approved rules below. Its predecessor identity
remains an immutable historical identity; it is not an alias. Historical
pending-approval or coefficient-unselected wording does not withhold the
specific grant recorded here. All other unavailable authorities remain gated.

Only the coefficient-slot binding changes: MAP may retrieve exact gamma_i=omega_i=1 after separate SCI-MAP permission and a requested, applicable, eligible, realized profile tied to exact family, q, g, support, payload, and provenance. MAP retains all existing admission, placement, exposure, coordinate, numerical classification, arithmetic, support, response, uncertainty, and failure rules. Registration does not realize a numerical route.
